test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some rice is white.

Some rice is brown.

No white is wheat.

**Conclusions:**

I) Some wheat is brown.

II) Some rice is not wheat.

III) Some brown is not white
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/780ba9eea2046860710d04915c802f4cef1d53be4b2d013fb7c3817abf71d583.png] 

Conclusions:

I) Some wheat is brown → False(As, no direct relation given between them so, it is not followed )

II) Some rice is not wheat → **True**(As, Some rice is white and No white is wheat. So, Some rice is not wheat is followed)

III) Some brown is not white → False(As, no direct relation is given between them so, it is not followed)

So, Conclusion II will followed.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
